kodaikanalGuide.whyBody: Kodaikanal is a Tamil Nadu hill station for mist, pine, and still water — not a rushed checklist. Canaan builds Kodaikanal tour packages around slow mornings, lake walks, and viewpoints that open when the fog lifts.
kodaikanalGuide.whenBody: March to June is pleasant for families. The monsoon months are green and quiet, with extra care on hill roads. October to February is cool and well suited to couples. Carry a light rain layer in every season.
kodaikanalGuide.doBody: Walk Kodai Lake, follow Coaker’s Walk through mist, stand at Dolphin’s Nose, pass through pine forest, and keep time for Poombarai, Mannavanur, and Silver Cascade. Sightseeing works best as two loops a day, not ten stops.
kodaikanalGuide.reachBody: Most guests fly into Madurai or Coimbatore, then take a private transfer into the hills. Canaan can arrange the climb so you arrive without changing cars at every junction.
kodaikanalGuide.stayBody: Choose a quiet hillside stay slightly away from the busiest market lanes if you want still mornings. Hotel help is available as a digital service around your package.
kodaikanalGuide.daysBody: A weekend (1 night / 2 days) covers our published core package. Ask Canaan for a custom longer stay if you want more forest, village, and waterfall time.
kodaikanalGuide.tipsBody: Start viewpoints early. Keep one trusted cab for the day. Pack walking shoes, a rain layer, and cash for small shops. If you want a premium pace, pre-book timings and private transfers.
kodaikanalGuide.faq1q: When is the best time to visit Kodaikanal?
kodaikanalGuide.faq1a: Summer (March–June) is the most comfortable for families. Winter is cooler and popular with couples. Monsoon is beautiful but needs slower driving.
kodaikanalGuide.faq2q: How many days do I need in Kodaikanal?
kodaikanalGuide.faq2a: Our published package is 1 night / 2 days. Tell Canaan if you want extra nights — custom plans are available for longer stays and larger groups.
kodaikanalGuide.faq3q: Are Canaan tours only for Kodaikanal?
kodaikanalGuide.faq3a: Our published tour package is for Kodaikanal. We also support flights, hotels, visas and travel planning for destinations worldwide.
kodaikanalGuide.faq4a: Fly to Madurai or Coimbatore, then continue by road. Private transfers make the hill climb easier, especially with children or elders.
kodaikanalGuide.faq5q: Do you offer honeymoon and family packages?
kodaikanalGuide.faq5a: Yes. Canaan has dedicated honeymoon, family, luxury, adventure, and complete Kodaikanal circuits. Enquire with your dates and we will shape the stay.

legal.privacyIntro: Canaan Travel Hub (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect when you use canaantravelhub.com and how we use it.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: When you submit an enquiry, we collect your name, email, phone number, travel dates, package interest, and any message you provide. We also receive basic technical data such as browser type when you browse the site.

use.title: How we use your information
use.body: We use enquiry details to respond to you, plan Kodaikanal packages, and provide digital travel services you request. We do not sell your personal data.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We may share necessary booking details with hotels, transport partners, or visa agents only to fulfil your request. We require partners to handle data responsibly.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site may use essential cookies for language preference and basic functionality. We do not use third-party advertising trackers at launch.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You may ask us to correct or delete enquiry data by emailing managingdirector@canaantravelhub.com or canaantravelhub@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.

contact.title: Contact
